children.title: The Institutional Geography of Expert Disagreement

detail.title: The Institutional Geography of Expert Disagreement
detail.summary: This provisional synthesis examines how scientific societies in the 19th and 20th centuries structured expert consensus and dissent, using the British Association for the Advancement of Science as a model case.
detail.reason: The evidence provides a concrete historical basis for how experts in the same discipline reached different conclusions based on institutional framing.
